description: Victoria's Future Climate Tool is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Energy, Environment, and Climate Action, VIC. Victoria's Future Climate Tool provides access to the most recent climate model simulations of Victoria's future climate and indicators of climate-related hazards for both high and medium emissions. The tool is interactive, allows to view future climate information (including temperature, rainfall and heatwaves) as maps and charts for local regions, including Local Government Areas (LGAs), and export climate data in a spatial format. Coverage is the states and territories, 2020 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and climate adaptation planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
